meta.title: Knowledge Kareem | كريم معرفة
meta.description: Share knowledge… make an impact — an internal knowledge-sharing initiative for our group of companies

hero.eyebrow: An internal knowledge-sharing initiative for our group
hero.headline: Share knowledge… make an impact.
hero.sub: Generosity isn’t only money — it can be knowledge you share. Knowledge Kareem turns our colleagues’ expertise into sessions everyone benefits from — today, and a year from now.

about.title: What is Knowledge Kareem?
about.body: Each of us carries knowledge earned through experience — a tool we’ve mastered, a way of working we’ve refined, a lesson learned the hard way. Knowledge Kareem makes sure that knowledge doesn’t stay locked in people’s heads: employees turn it into sessions and workshops for colleagues across our group — technical, management, creative, or lessons from real experience.

provider.title: Share your knowledge
provider.step1Body: Tell us your proposed topic in a minute
provider.step2Body: The initiative team reaches out and helps you shape your session
provider.step3Body: Deliver your session and leave an impact that outlasts it

attendee.title: Learn from your colleagues
attendee.step1Body: Browse upcoming sessions once the platform launches
attendee.step2Body: Book your seat in the sessions that interest you
attendee.step3Body: Learn, join the discussion, and earn points

recognition.title: Build your name — not just your points
recognition.body: Every session you give or attend earns you points — and adds to your company’s standing across the group. But what matters more: your name becomes tied to the knowledge you shared, and your impact stays with your colleagues. At the end of the year, we celebrate our most generous contributors.

policy.title: You don’t need to be an expert
policy.intro: The best sessions aren’t academic lectures — they’re real experiences. Any one of these is enough:
policy.card1Body: A tangible result you achieved at work that others can repeat
policy.card2Body: Something you used yourself, with what worked and what didn’t
policy.card3Title: A lesson that changed your thinking
policy.card3Body: An experience or mistake that changed how you work
policy.closer: If you have one of these, you have a session.

finalCta.title: Be among the first to share — and the first to know
finalCta.body: The platform launches soon. Register your interest now and we’ll email you the moment it goes live.

footer.privacy: Your email is used only for the Knowledge Kareem initiative — never shared with anyone else.
